 FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Leeds United 
 Leeds boss Daniel Farke to BBC Match Of The Day on Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel: "I haven't watched anything back so can't give you a clear opinion. During the game it was just in front of my feet. 
 "I think it was just a coming together. Jayden Bogle is more of a butterfly than an eagle and the most fair play [player] in this league if I'm honest.
 "Of course I feel for Mathys Tel and hopefully he can recover well and he's not badly injured. Jayden would never injure a player on purpose."

 FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Tottenham Hotspur 
 Tottenham head coach Roberto De Zerbi to BBC Match Of The Day: "The second half we didn't show the same spirit. We didn't show the hunger we need for these types of big games. In the first half we played well, we were working hard in these days and knew before the game the intensity of Leeds but we were not capable of playing better. We have to analyse. Many games like this can be a problem for us."
 On Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel: "I was surprised on the yellow card for Pedro Porro because it was clear. The potential red card, I couldn't say. We have full confidence in the referee and VAR. I cannot sat nothing more. Tel has a bad injury on his ankle, but I don't know how long [he will be out] yet."

 'Confidence in the referee' published at 15:10 GMT 15:10 GMT 
 FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Tottenham Hotspur 
 Tottenham head coach Roberto De Zerbi to TNT Sports : "We deserved to lose the game in the second half and didn't play like we can. It's a journey for us, because we can learn from this game. I am sorry for the performance in the second half - we didn't play like a top team. We didn't have the right character and physicality in the second half."
 On a booking for Pedro Porro compared to Jayden Bogle's tackle on Mathys Tel: "Pedro Porro's was a duel and an incredible yellow card. The first situation of Mathys Tel I didn't see, I can't say nothing."
 On if the referee should have gone to the monitor: "No. I have big confidence in the referee. Nothing changes if he goes to the monitor. If they didn't take the right decision I don't know. We have to keep the eyes on the performance where can improve."

 'Bogle is a butterfly' published at 15:07 GMT 15:07 GMT 
 FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham 
 Leeds United 
 Leeds boss Daniel Farke to TNT Sports: "We were pushing to win this game and were relentless. We showed great spirit, commitment and unity. It was a fully deserved win."
 On Jayden Bogle's foul on Mathys Tel: "I haven't watched it back. I have heard there were several doubtful situations. A possible hand ball. I just know that Jayden Bogle out of any bad intention. It looked like a coming together. 
 "It's very unlucky outcome that Mathys is injured and we wish him all the best and he can recover quickly. The last thing Jayden Bogle is a nasty player. He's possibly the softest player in the whole league. I always call him my butterfly, and I can guarantee it was never out of bad intention."

 'Newcastle lack the fight' published at 15:05 GMT 15:05 GMT 
 Fulham 0-0 Newcastle 
 Fara Williams 
Former England midfielder on Final Score 
 Newcastle have had an inconsistent start, they've had no draws, they've just won or lost. 
 They've lost key players in the summer and they haven't been able to spend. 
 Newcastle fans can turn when results don't go their way. They've lacked the fight they had under Eddie Howe.
